reference: SPEC §9 Phase 5: 10 published matching reports must reproduce koota points. Rows with `expected` are full reports with bride and groom named (all eight kootas compared exactly). Rows with kind 'pair' are published pair pages that do not name the bride: only the direction-independent kootas are compared, and any disagreement is recorded, not hidden. Illustrative rows do not count. A person should confirm every row (verified: true).

bhakoot.why: Vrishabha–Tula is a 6/8 placement (Bhakoot dosha, 0 by the standard rule, kootas.json). Both signs are ruled by Shukra, a traditional cancellation; AskSoma evidently awards the full 7 when the dosha is cancelled. The app keeps raw points and reports cancellations separately. Convention difference, not changed.
